Bullington communications mast

WindReach Telecom operates a lattice communications mast on Bullington ridge providing radio relay and microwave backhaul. It is a telecom mast, not a wind turbine.

2352ed6c356124c5f334bff3245b2a51b4528dac.text: <html><body><article>Residents confirmed the ridge structure is a communications mast installed for mobile and emergency-services coverage near Bullington.</article></body></html>
